scope: Development-only metric derivation on the completed fresh-v3 panel. A second disjoint authority will be required for confirmation.
hypothesis: The remaining MLP ranking error comes from downstream path sensitivity. Contracting each exact donor-minus-base MLP carrier response with the native answer-minus-foil Jacobian at that same component and position will predict the finite causal patch better than target-read response norm alone.
primary_score: Mean absolute first-order directional effect |sum_carrier <gradient of answer-minus-foil margin with respect to MLP output, donor-minus-base MLP output>|, computed on A1 rows only and averaged without fitting.

predictions.pred_a_exact_gradient_response_pairing_a: Every task/layer/row response is paired at exact carrier positions; all scores and gradient checks are finite.
predictions.pred_b_path_conditioning_improves_both_d: Spearman against the already-frozen fresh A2 causal effects exceeds the local conditioned baselines 0.500 has/had and 0.3833 is/was for both tasks.
predictions.pred_c_path_conditioning_is_strong_enoug: Both correlations exceed 0.65 and MLP4 ranks in the top three for both tasks.
predictions.pred_d_zero_fit_and_declared_development: No fitted parameter or model update; this result can only nominate a formula for a later disjoint test.

decision: screen graduates the frozen Jacobian-contracted formula to a second disjoint causal authority; null redirects to finite-difference or higher-order suffix sensitivity; invalid on position, response, gradient, matching, finiteness, or accounting failure
